statement: At Linux v7.4-rc2 the USB configuration path carries an eight-byte command header over bulk OUT and receives replies on bulk IN. The HID Nintendo controller startup sequences serial/firmware information and factory/user stick calibration reads, feature mask and enable commands, rumble activation and Pro report 0x09 selection, using the configuration attachment before enabling its evdev path. Retail command acceptance and version-specific side effects are unmeasured.
